messages:
Ana: Quick heads-up — OnPrem EdgeLite v1.0 is going GA today for customers who requested a minimal telemetry footprint. Main point: tenant-scoped telemetry toggle (opt-out by default). Posting rollout window, customer-readiness checklist, and a couple of small ops notes below. Ping me for any customer-specific concerns. :party:
release-bot: release-edge-lite@v1.0 tagged and artifacts uploaded to private-repo (s3://internal-releases/edge-lite/v1.0). Rollout window: 2025-06-24 22:00 UTC → 2025-06-25 02:00 UTC. Canary 10% first hour. :shipit:
Samir: quick q — default telemetry state is opt-out, right? we had one customer who wanted opt-in only.
Ana: correct — default is opt-out. For Hosted/Dedicated customers telemetry remains off unless expressly enabled. For Private/on-prem customers we default to off and provide the tenant toggle in the console or via cluster agent.
Gillian: Security update: KMS/HSM integration test matrix ✅. No new keys required; rotation flows unchanged. I'll add an audit checklist item for explicit telemetry consent recording.
ops-bot: Canary started in us-west1, eu-west1, ap-south1 — all checks passing (latency, health, agent heartbeats) in the last 10m. No 5xxs.
support-oncall: Support/CS note — weekend launch coverage: oncall rotation for the window will be @Samir and @Gillian (backup: @Ana). Please triage with high priority if customers report agent connectivity.
Ana: Customer-readiness checklist (short):
- Confirm customer has firewall port 15012 open for agent mgmt endpoint.
- Ensure KMS/HSM credentials available if they want encrypted telemetry payloads.
- Decide telemetry preference (opt-out/opt-in) and record consent in the onboarding doc.
- Run preflight script and share results with Solutions ENG.
Snippet to toggle tenant telemetry via agent API:
````
curl -X POST https://management.customer.example/api/v1/tenants/1234/telemetry -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"enabled":false}'
````
Samir: noted. Any breaking changes to the agent network ports or certs?
Ana: No breaking changes to certs. Agent now exposes a management endpoint on port 15012 (new) — previously we only used 15011 for runtime. Please update customer firewall rules accordingly.
Gillian: Also add a note for Compliance: when telemetry is enabled, we attach only hashed metric keys and never raw prompt text. We've documented the hashing scheme and retention window in the compliance pack. I'll link the PR in the docs channel.
Ana: I'll send the customer email template after this thread and update the Console with the new "Tenant telemetry" checkbox. Thanks everyone — monitoring is on for the next 4 hours. :rotating_light:
